_comment: One copy, because there were nearly two. tests/world.py needs this list to seed
departments for V29 and V30, and scripts/console-smoke.sh needs to serve it from a
stub Village so the same two rules can evaluate in the smoke environment. A second
hand-kept copy of the twelve is exactly the shape this repository keeps closing -
The Office already carried its own department tuple once, nine of the twelve names
were wrong, and nothing failed because nothing checked.
It is the response shape rather than a convenient one so that the stub can return
the file as-is and the fetch path is the real one.
